name: Italian Pasta Salad with Roasted Chicken, Fennel, Peppers & Artichokes

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 fennel bulbs
3 red bell peppers
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulbs. Halve fennel bulbs lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Divide between two large baking sheet pans.
Trim, seed, and large dice bell peppers. Add to the baking sheets with the fennel.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels, large dice, and add to the baking sheets. Drizzle chicken and veggies with oil, then season with spices. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp oregano, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until chicken is cooked through and veggies are tender, 20-25 minutes.

Meanwhile, fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water to cool. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g penne pasta

instructions.primary_message: While the pasta is cooking, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic. Place in a large bowl along with oil, vinegar, salt, and crushed red pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp balsamic vinegar
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Drain and thinly slice artichoke hearts and sun-dried tomatoes. Add both to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (170 ml) jars artichoke hearts, marinated
18 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed

instructions.primary_message: When the chicken and veggies are done, remove from the oven. Add to the bowl, along with cooled pasta, and stir to combine.
To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
